first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A

entities.name: black hanging rod

entities.name: gray corridor floor

entities.name: vertically striped corridor side wall

entities.name: green arrow sign

entities.name: white muzzle smoke

entities.name: group of people at the distant doorway

entities.name: scattered white papers in the corridor

entities.name: light-colored cylinder in the corridor side room
